_comment: Thresholds for the ordinal escape-risk band. Separated from the code so the rule is inspectable and can be pinned by eval/protocol.py when this is eventually wired in. Changing a number here changes every band, so it is a reviewable diff.

downgrade_one_band_when.multi_copy_target: A resistance SNP in a multi-copy target is recessive: wild-type copies still produce drug-sensitive product, so a single mutation event is not enough.
